name: APIVerveHashtagGenerator
summary: Hashtag Generator creates relevant hashtags from any plain text or post caption.
description:
Hashtag Generator creates relevant hashtags from any plain text or post caption. Pass in a text snippet to receive an array of suggested social tags, with paid plans able to customize the tag count.

This iOS/macOS SDK provides a convenient way to access the Hashtag Generator from APIVerve.
Supports both callback-based and async/await patterns.
